meta.name: document-gen-resilient-workflow
meta.description: Robust document generation with engine fallback chain, error diagnostics, and Python alternatives

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成文档时自动切换引擎并诊断错误
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在文档生成时处理引擎故障和错误诊断
copy.tagline_en: Generate documents with automatic engine fallback and error diagnostics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need robust document generation with engine fallback and error diagnostics

howto.what: 安装后，Claude在文档生成时会先验证工作区和工具可用性，然后逐步尝试多种转换引擎（如pandoc、xelatex、wkhtmltopdf），并捕获错误。若全部失败，则使用Python库（fpdf2、python-docx）作为备选。最后验证输出文件。
howto.when: 当文档生成任务遇到工具错误（如run_shell返回unknown error）、PDF生成因Unicode或引擎缺失失败、工作空间路径问题，或shell_agent多次失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成季度报告的DOCX和PDF
使用xelatex引擎生成PDF，以支持特殊字符
如果pandoc失败，改用Python fpdf2生成PDF

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will validate the workspace and tool availability, then try multiple conversion engines (pandoc, xelatex, wkhtmltopdf) with error capture. If all fail, it uses Python libraries (fpdf2, python-docx). Finally verifies output files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when document generation tasks encounter tool errors like 'unknown error' from run_shell, PDF failures due to Unicode or missing engines, workspace issues, or repeated shell_agent failures.

say_en.text: Generate the quarterly report in DOCX and PDF.
Use xelatex engine for PDF to support special characters.
say_en.note: Claude will try xelatex as the PDF engine.

say_en.text: If pandoc fails, use Python fpdf2 to generate PDF.
say_en.note: Claude will fall back to the Python alternative.
